dossier_meta.context_text: $X_R$ denotes the Cayley graph constructed from a finite ring $R$ using its group of units and a connection set derived from the ring structure. This question is the central driving question of Section 4, and is reduced first to the semisimple case (showing non-semisimple $R$ gives non-prime $X_R$) and then to a combinatorial question about tensor products of complete graphs.
